description: Native unprocessed source interval from the four-mode courtyard recording. Green-box and moved modes are excluded from detector inputs.

Subtitle background is fully opaque black by user configuration.
Only clean initial mode is replayed. Seek UI, t69, diagnostic boxes, and replacement outputs are excluded.
